days.label: Fri 28 Aug 2026

rows.headline: Crescendo launches AI-native unified CX platform
rows.sowhat: A new vendor is bundling CCaaS, ticketing, WFM, QA, VoC, and knowledge with specialized AI agents—an architectural claim that demands proof at scale.

rows.headline: CrowdStrike, Okta tie Q2 strength to AI security
rows.sowhat: Two enterprise security vendors flag autonomous agent security as the new demand driver, not infrastructure defence—a notable enterprise positioning shift.

rows.headline: ibex partners Sierra for managed AI-to-human handoff
rows.sowhat: A contact-centre outsourcer now integrates Wave iX, Sierra, and human agents as one operational layer—testing whether agentic CX can scale in BPO.

rows.headline: Salesforce launches outcome-based pricing for Agentforce
rows.sowhat: Salesforce is pricing on business outcomes, not seats, preparing for a market where AI agents displace the traditional CRM user model.

rows.headline: HP Q3 earnings show Poly becoming workplace platform
rows.sowhat: HP is repositioning Poly from devices into a broader workplace platform play, signalling a shift in how collaboration hardware vendors compete.

rows.headline: Zoom Q2 driven by enterprise and AI growth
rows.sowhat: Zoom's enterprise revenue hit a three-year high, validating its shift toward AI-enabled contact centre and digital labour tools.

rows.headline: Mitel research finds workers drowning in comms tools
rows.sowhat: Mitel-backed survey flags fragmentation as a productivity drag, reinforcing the case for unified AI orchestration layers across workplace tech.

rows.headline: Google launches Gemini Enterprise for legal sector
rows.sowhat: Google is targeting enterprise legal with governed AI connectors and compliance controls, addressing a vertical where confidentiality blocks adoption.

days.pattern_watch: AI security and agent governance emerging as distinct enterprise spend drivers (CrowdStrike/Okta + Google legal AI).

days.label: Thu 27 Aug 2026

rows.headline: Salesforce reports record Q2, raises full-year guidance
rows.sowhat: Strong AI-led growth and a $10bn Anthropic gain signal that seat-based SaaS revenue can still expand alongside agentic automation—at least for now.

rows.headline: Salesforce, Anthropic launch Claudeforce—CRM inside Claude
rows.sowhat: This signals a potential post-UI strategy where the CRM becomes headless infrastructure callable by third-party AI agents, not just a Salesforce-controlled front end.

rows.headline: TTEC Digital completes first Agentforce Contact Center deployment
rows.sowhat: Compass Working Capital's live go-live gives Salesforce a public proof point that enterprise CCaaS buyers can actually put agentic agents into production.

rows.headline: Zoom Q2 revenue up 4.9%, Enterprise up 7.8%
rows.sowhat: Consolidation is driving enterprise growth, but single-digit top-line expansion shows the UC-to-CCaaS bundle isn't yet a high-velocity revenue lever.

rows.headline: Cisco Webex launches AI Agent for CCE 15
rows.sowhat: Webex AI Agent extends intelligent self-service to on-prem CCE deployments, preserving enterprise control while bringing agentic capabilities to legacy estates.

rows.headline: Sangoma partners with Jazzware on hospitality UC-PMS integration
rows.sowhat: Connecting UC platforms to property-management systems pushes vertical differentiation deeper into the channel's back-office stack, not just telephony features.

rows.headline: Infobip launches SIM-based Number Verification for operators
rows.sowhat: Carriers gain a revenue share by monetising SIM-based authentication, reducing SMS OTP abuse and opening a channel margin play in enterprise identity flows.

rows.headline: Google bids $10m for bankrupt Spirit Airlines' corporate data
rows.sowhat: This creates a market for enterprise operational data as AI training collateral, raising questions for CIOs about data sovereignty when a business fails.

days.pattern_watch: Salesforce + Anthropic integration across CRM and CCaaS signals headless-CRM architecture thread.
